summary: Backend-only test of the self bot / Lua script / joiner flow. 16/16 pytest tests pass. Checked: client.lua, selfbot.lua and bot.lua?token= are served with __API__/__BOT_TOKEN__ filled in and pass luac5.1 -p. All three contain buildUI/ScreenGui, scan() (Plots > AnimalPodiums > AnimalOverhead, reading DisplayName/Mutation/Generation), deepScan() capped at 4.5s and hop(). The selfbot and bot scripts also call queue_on_teleport. A bad bot token gets 401. Owner selfbot status/set works and toggles settings.owner_selfbot. A non-owner gets 403 on both, and a wrong owner hwid gets 403. An owner report with Skibidi Toilet Gold, Dragon Cannelloni $250M/s and Noobini Pizzanini inserted 2 logs (og and peak; Noobini was filtered out) and recorded a run (runs+1, logged+2). A King user polling right after got both logs with job_id and place_id, both with the default 8s window and with since set to the auth server_time. A Russian user does not get OG logs. A non-owner report with selfbot=true inserts logs but records no run. A user with no slot gets empty poll logs, and /script/auth returns 402 for them. /script/settings auto_join=false is saved and shows up in /script/auth and /script/poll; a wrong hwid gets 403. /logs/ingest records a run with source 'bot', and it shows in admin overview selfbot_runs. Setting min_log_value to 0 lets a $5/s Noobini be logged with tier 'low'. Cleanup done: temp users, slots, logs and runs removed, owner_selfbot=true, min_log_value=1000000, owner key and hwid unchanged. In-game Roblox execution was not tested.

minor.issue: No dedupe: if a hop fails (TeleportInitFailed), the selfbot or bot rescans the same server after 6s and reports it again. The same brainrot and job_id get logged twice, and joiners can be sent to the same server twice.
No cap on the brainrots list (report caps it at 120).
Docs have no 'source' field (only ingest sets source='bot'). Add source='selfbot' so the admin UI can tell them apart.

action_items: Optional: skip a log when the same name+mutation+job_id was logged in the last ~60s
Optional: cap the brainrots list in Ingest at 120, the same as in Report
Optional: add source='selfbot' to selfbot_runs inserted by /script/report
critical_code_review_comments: Poll race: the client sets since=server_time (t). insert_log sets created_at before its insert, so a log created just before t but inserted after the poll query may be missed. Consider since = server_time minus 1-2s; the client already dedupes with seen[log.id].

scan() runs workspace:GetDescendants() on every deepScan loop pass (every 0.35s, for up to 4.5s). On a full server this may cause frame hitches. The Plots/AnimalPodiums pass already covers most cases, so the full descendant walk could run only once or only as a fallback.
OWNER_SELFBOT: if hop() fails, the loop scans and reports the same server again after task.wait(6). It would be better to retry hop() several times before rescanning.
